title: Decoy CLI version document
description: The Decoy-hosted document the CLI reads to learn the current version and where the signed per-target bundles live. It can be served as static JSON behind a CDN. The client sends no data and no identifiers; it only GETs this document. Every field is optional with a defined default so an older CLI reading a newer document degrades cleanly (api-and-compatibility).

schema_version.description: The document schema version. A client that does not recognize a newer value still reads the fields it knows.

latest.description: The current recommended CLI version (PEP 440). The startup notice and `decoy upgrade` compare against this.

min_supported.description: The lowest version still supported (PEP 440). A client below this may show a stronger upgrade prompt. Advisory; omit to impose no floor.

yanked.description: Versions that were published then withdrawn. A client on a yanked version is advised to upgrade.

message.description: An optional advisory message shown with the notice (e.g. a security-fix note). Plain text.

artifacts.description: Per-target published bundle for `latest`. Keys are bundle target strings (linux-x86_64, linux-aarch64, windows-x86_64, macos-arm64).

url.description: URL of the per-target bundle tarball.

sig.description: URL of the detached signature over the SHA256SUMS manifest.
